evidence.title: Alberta’s iGaming market opening explained and what happened after July 13?

summary: Alberta’s government officially opened its regulated iGaming market on July 13, permitting licensed operators to offer online gambling services to residents. In the weeks after launch, the province has reported a rapid increase in operator registrations, rising revenue, and ongoing refinements to licensing and consumer‑protection rules.
title: Alberta launches regulated iGaming market, outlining developments since July 13
